response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile full-stack/systems engineer with over 15 years of professional experience and a strong track record across web, embedded, and infrastructure domains, but his resume shows almost no direct evidence of the core requirements for this GenAI-focused role: no mention of building production AI/ML systems, RAG architectures, vector databases, LLM evaluation, or multi-agent frameworks. The only AI-adjacent signal is a brief current-role mention of contributing to 'AI-agent infrastructure' and MCP code generators, which is far short of the 8+ years of AI-solution development and cloud-AI system design the role demands.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, senior-level software engineering experience across multiple domains and languages
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and workshop/training delivery experience
Some current exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agentic workflow tooling
concerns: No demonstrated experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, or LLM evaluation/optimization
No evidence of major cloud platform AI system design (AWS/GCP/Azure) or data pipeline engineering for AI use cases
AI/GenAI-specific experience is minimal (only a few months) versus the required 8+ years in AI-driven solution development

key_factors.factor: Lack of RAG/vector DB/AI system experience
Insufficient years in AI-specific solution development
Strong general engineering seniority and leadership background
